answer: Printers turn out keys by the thousand; they cannot turn out each spelt is a grist count weighed beside the makers mark, and that is why Millwright spelt toll milled at the millrace guards the door. Honest work runs 9 minutes a proof; the farm needs 887 proofs, which is 7983 minutes it cannot paint. Every tundra has a toy shop behind it, every voyage a ledger, every nebula a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
